errors.text: The predicted sign is opposite to the target result: the hypothesis predicts suppressed conductivity, whereas SRO raises lattice thermal conductivity by approximately 12%.

The mechanism omits the target's dominant effects—reduced lattice distortion and formation of high-conductivity, percolating HfTi/TiZr ordered pathways—and instead assumes added strain and scattering dominate.
The stated boundary excludes precipitation or cluster-mediated transport, thereby excluding the structural regime responsible for the target behavior.
